Overview
This training manual is for people or organizations wanting to train helpers to deliver Group Problem Management Plus (PM+). It contains all the information needed to deliver a training and implement PM+. Part A covers key information for setting up and implementing Group PM+, including how to use the manual, training and supervision requirements and how to deliver training and conduct competency-based assessments. Part B provides detailed instructions for delivering a training.
Group Problem Management Plus (‎Group PM+)‎: group psychological help for adults impaired by distress in communities exposed to adversity, is a 5-session, evidence-based, psychological intervention for adults impaired by psychological distress.
The Group PM+ intervention manual can be found at:
